component_findings.build_execute: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-1--c): 0-100 = sum of five 0-20 sub-scores, each scored against the same fixed criteria for every language: (1) Compiler availability/quality: number and independence of actively-maintained, standards-conformant compiler implementations; (2) Build-system tooling: availability and maturity of a de-facto standard build/generator toolchain; (3) Debugger maturity: cross-platform source-level debugger availability and IDE/toolchain integration; (4) Static analysis/formatting/sanitizer tooling maturity; (5) Editor-agnostic tooling protocol (LSP or equivalent) maturity and adoption.

metric.package_dependency_management_qua.candidate_universe: Evidence drawn from the two most prominent, officially-documented C++ package managers identified by third-party comparison sources (vcpkg, Conan) plus one independent comparison article, via two predeclared web searches: (a) package-manager ecosystem/registry query, (b) registry size/fragmentation query. Predeclared target selection: vcpkg and Conan chosen as the two dominant tools per multiple independent comparison sources, not by search-result order.
